property_summary: For every caller address that is an EOA (no code) the reference C.proxiableUUID() returns the IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT constant; the mutant returns a different constant (ADMIN_SLOT) for some caller addresses (when called as a non-delegated direct call) so asserting proxiableUUID()==ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT is a universal rule the reference satisfies and the mutant violates for some fuzzed caller addresses.
change_summary: Replace returned slot with a different constant (returns ADMIN_SLOT instead of IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT).
